name: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace
summary: A faded writ requests one Heavy Bronze Mace and gives terms for its delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: The note is written in faded ink, and the customer asks for a Heavy Bronze Mace. You are to bring the requested item to the place marked on your map. Keep the writ with you, for it is required to complete the exchange.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Heavy Bronze Mace.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the mace?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the note say about payment?
faq.answer: The note includes information about payment, but the provided text does not give the amount.

faq.q: Can someone else use the writ?
faq.answer: The writing at the bottom says the writ is transferable.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace
